youtube.title: Shapes Are Everywhere ⭐ Peekaboo Shapes Song for Toddlers | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Sing Shapes Are Everywhere with Robo! Five shapes play peekaboo behind Robo's shape sorter box: a corner peeks out, guess the shape, 3, 2, 1, and out it pops. Then find each shape in the playroom (a round clock, a square present, a triangle sail, a star on the toy box and a heart card), draw it in the air, and drop it into its hole in the shape box: circle, square, triangle, star and heart.

What your child learns: the names of five shapes (circle, square, triangle, star and heart), what makes each one (round with no corners, four equal sides, three corners, five points, round on top with a point below), spotting shapes in everyday things, and drawing shapes in the air, a first step toward writing.

Sing at home: play peekaboo with a shape cut from paper behind a book, look around your room for circles and squares, and draw each shape in the air with your finger as Robo does. The words and the tune of Shapes Are Everywhere are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
